subject: Pricing & budget alignment for Finex AI pilot
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Roy <aisha.roy@finex.ai>, Tom Baxter <tom.baxter@finex.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing & budget alignment for Finex AI pilot

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation. Quick recap + a few asks so we can move to a pilot SOW: 

1) Recap of what we heard
- Pilot scope: embeddings + RAG for docs search (initially ~3M tokens/month for retrieval + generation traffic spikes during search)
- Target latency: 150-250ms p50 for retrieval path
- Data controls: VPC + audit logs required

2) Cost / pricing items to confirm (helpful if you can loop in finance):
- Monthly token volumes: you mentioned starting ~3M tokens/month, expected to grow to 10-15M within 3 months — please confirm range we should price to.
- Target unit economics: what is acceptable $/1M tokens for you as a benchmark? We typically propose tiered pricing that hits $X–$Y per 1M depending on committed volume and reserved capacity.
- Budget owner / economic buyer: can you confirm who signs off on pricing and procurement?

3) Next steps
- Marissa (me) will draft a simple cost model + sample SOW and circulate (cc'ing Rishi + Ethan).
- Aisha/Tom: confirm the budget range and who from Finance should be included.

Attachments: none in this note; will attach cost model/SOW in follow-up.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Aisha Roy <aisha.roy@finex.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Baxter <tom.baxter@finex.ai>, Finance Ops <finance@finex.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing & budget alignment for Finex AI pilot

Hi Marissa — thanks for the summary, that matches what we discussed. A few clarifications for your cost model: 

- Monthly volumes: we expect to start at ~3M tokens/month in month 1, ramping to ~12-15M tokens/month by month 3. We plan to throttle non-critical generation to control cost.
- Target $/1M tokens: finance is looking for a ballpark in the $40–$65 per 1M tokens range for production traffic; for a pilot they can stretch a bit if we show clear ROI.
- Budget owner / economic buyer: Tom Baxter (VP Product) is the economic buyer for platform spend. For formal procurement sign-off, cc'd Finance Ops (finance@finex.ai) — they'll handle PO and T&Cs.

Tom and Finance: can you confirm availability this week for a quick pricing walk-through?

Best,
Aisha
Head of ML Product | Finex AI
aisha.roy@finex.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pricing & budget alignment for Finex AI pilot

Forwarding Aisha's note — pls see volumes and the $40–$65 target range.

Ethan: can you validate the unit-economics assumptions below and draft two quick options:
- Option A (Pilot, reserved small capacity): assume 3-5M tokens/month, price X per 1M, recommend quantization/shorter context to reduce cost.
- Option B (Ramp to committed): assume 12-15M tokens/month, reserved capacity pricing, target toward lower $/1M (aim for $45-50/1M).

Rishi: I'll prepare a concise cost model + SOW draft to share with Finex. If you have an objection to the target $/1M bands call it out.

Thanks — target to have a draft to send by EOD Thu.

—Marissa

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pricing & budget alignment for Finex AI pilot

Sounds good — quick notes from my side: 

- Agreed bands: Pilot (3-5M): $70/1M tokens (on hosted, no commit) or $55/1M with a 3-month reserved commit.
- Ramp (12-15M): target $45–$50/1M with a 6-12 month reserved contract and minor SLA uplift.
- Include optional Dedicated path pricing for their security/VPC needs — that's a different unit economics (lower per-token at scale but minimum monthly).

Ethan: can you include an example that shows monthly spend at 3M, 8M, and 15M tokens with and without caching/batching savings (we typically show 20-35% effective token reduction with caching)?

I don't have objections to the bands — but we'll want Finance to confirm that Tom (economic buyer) is comfortable with the committed ranges.

Rishi
Head of Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Roy <aisha.roy@finex.ai>, Tom Baxter <tom.baxter@finex.ai>, Finance Ops <finance@finex.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Aug 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing proposal & next steps — Finex AI pilot (draft SOW + cost model attached)

Hi Aisha / Tom / Finance — attaching a short SOW draft and a cost model that lays out the two options Rishi and Ethan scoped:

- Pilot: 3-5M tokens/month (no long-term commit) — Hosted pricing: $70/1M tokens; Reserved 3-month commit: $55/1M tokens.
- Ramp: 12-15M tokens/month — Reserved 6-12 month commit: $45/1M tokens; includes optional Dedicated (VPC) pricing as appendix.

Assumptions called out in the model: % caching savings, expected token split (retrieval vs. generation), and estimated monthly average latency SLO impact.

Ask: please confirm by reply:
1) Is Tom the economic buyer to approve the pricing bands above?
2) Who from Finance should I include to handle PO / procurement cadence (we have Finance Ops cc'd but need the individual name/contact)?
3) Any concerns on pricing bands — if the $45-50 target at 12-15M is unrealistic, call it out and we can propose alternatives (e.g., shorter commit + smaller guaranteed throughput).

Next steps: once we have confirmation on buyer + finance contact, I'll share an updated SOW and calendar for a 30-min pricing review later this week.

Attachments:
- Finex_SOW_draft_v1.pdf (SOW stub)
- Finex_Cost_Model_2026.xlsx (cost model with scenarios)

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
